ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels. White intensity is concentrated on the distal lateral lobes, while black intensity dominates the proximal and axial regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white fields at the left and right tips. The left white field contains isolated, high-contrast circular black spots. The right white field is more fragmented, featuring vertical black striations and dense clusters of black circular blobs.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an estimated pixel angle of 45-50 degrees; notch boundaries are sharp and well-defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular macro-serration along the entire trailing boundary. The right lobe exhibits a prominent jagged section with 5-7 distinct high-amplitude peaks. The left lobe shows smoother, lower-amplitude variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to acute, slightly upward-swept lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular black pixel clusters distributed within the white regions of both lobes. Distinct cluster of high-intensity white calcified barnacle colonies visible on the far right lateral margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned light-colored linear streaks traversing the central dark pigmentation (rake marks). Vertical black linear disruptions intersect the white field on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable accumulation of barnacles on the right distal tip edge. Visible irregular indentation (notch) on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive eye-like pattern on the left lobe consisting of a single dark circular spot centered within a larger white field.
